before.prompt: Suppose Gold 1 follows your lateral move. What deserves another look?

options.text: The original shot as though Gold 1 had stayed still
A shot without checking the blocker
A pass to D2 or another change of angle

before.explanation: A moving defender can close the new lane, so alternatives remain relevant.

after.prompt: YOU are weighing the two teammate passes before another shot. Which direct passing line stays farther from Gold 1 in this view?

options.text: The pass from YOU to D2
The pass from YOU to F1

after.explanation: The line to D2 stays farther from Gold 1 than the line to F1. That makes D2 an option to assess around the current blocker. F1 is farther toward the net and may offer a useful attacking option if that lane remains available. More distance from one defender does not guarantee reception or make D2 the best play in every situation.

optionReasons.reason: D2 is a real teammate. The direct puck-to-D2 segment stays farther from Gold1 than the puck-to-F1 segment. D2 may change the angle but a completed pass/next shot is unproven.

F1 is a real advanced teammate. Its direct segment has less separation from Gold1 but still several metres of point separation; do not call it blocked or wrong generally. It offers a different attacking tradeoff.

geometry.method: Canonical makeScene rendered puck, player receiving centres, finite direct-pass segments and Euclidean point-to-segment minimum distances. No player motion or pass simulated.

duplicateAudit.distinction: q7 identifies D2 against an opponent/goalie; new q5 compares D2 with actual advanced teammate F1, preserves F1’s conditional value and measures the direct lines.

limits: Two genuine same-category choices used; no third real receiving option exists in these selected-player scenes. Chance success is 50%; response is not mastery proof.
Static point geometry does not encode stick reach, body width, skating, passing speed, gaze, interceptions or receiver readiness.
No scene setup or actor moved; no hypothetical event presented as visible.
Q003 phrasing room around line means spacing to the shown gold skaters, not obstruction by every rink feature. Neither compared segment intersects a net or boards.
